summary: UY Scuti Acquisition Corp. (SPAC) filed an 8-K disclosing a promissory note evidencing a $450,000 loan from Sun Peisha (Lender, designee of Sponsor UY Scuti Investments Limited) to extend the deadline for an initial business combination to July 1, 2026. The unsecured, non-interest-bearing note is repayable upon consummation of the pending merger with Isdera Group Limited and Xinghui Automotive Technology, convertible into units at $10.00 per unit (one ordinary share plus a right for 1/5 share). The filing shows ongoing extension financing with no stated premium. What to watch: risk of non-completion and forced delisting if extension fails or merger collapses.
